sop_modules.name: Mobilization & Access Setup
sop_modules.description: Crew mobilization, equipment staging, and scaffold/lift setup for exterior wood siding repaint.

tasks.name: Crew Mobilization & Equipment Staging
tasks.description: Mobilize crew, transport materials and equipment to site. Stage paint, primer, prep tools at work area.

quality_notes.all: All materials on-site and verified against scope. Equipment in working order.

tasks.name: Scaffold / Lift Setup
tasks.description: Erect scaffold, position aerial lift, or stage extension ladders per access plan. OSHA-compliant setup.

quality_notes.all: Level, plumb, tied off. Fall protection in place. Base plates on firm footing.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Mobilize → Scaffold/lift setup before any other work.

sop_modules.name: Condition Assessment & Lead Evaluation
sop_modules.description: MANDATORY first module for repaint. Visual/tactile DSD rating, adhesion test, moisture content test, existing coating identification, and lead evaluation for pre-1978 buildings. DSD-4 = HARD STOP.

tasks.name: Condition Assessment — DSD Rating & Adhesion Test
tasks.description: Visual and tactile assessment of existing coating condition. Assign DSD rating (0-4). Perform ASTM D3359 cross-hatch adhesion test on representative areas of each elevation. Document findings.

quality_notes.QT2: DSD rating and adhesion test on worst and best areas per elevation.
quality_notes.QT3: DSD rating per elevation. Adhesion test at 3+ points per elevation.
quality_notes.QT4: Comprehensive DSD map. Adhesion test at 5+ points per elevation. Photo documentation.

tasks.name: Moisture Content Testing
tasks.description: Pin-type moisture meter readings on representative boards. Wood MC must be ≤15% for latex, ≤12% for alkyd. Test shaded and sun-exposed areas, near grade, under eaves.

quality_notes.all: Minimum 3 readings per elevation. Record all readings. Flag any area >15% MC for deferral.

tasks.name: Existing Coating Identification
tasks.description: Identify existing coating type — latex vs alkyd. Solvent rub test (MEK or denatured alcohol): latex softens, alkyd does not. Critical for primer and topcoat compatibility.

quality_notes.all: Test each elevation. Document latex vs alkyd finding. Note any evidence of multiple coating types.

tasks.name: Lead Paint Evaluation (Pre-1978)
tasks.description: Test for lead paint on pre-1978 buildings before any paint disturbance. EPA RRP-certified tester. XRF or EPA-recognized test kit. If positive, RRP containment and cleanup procedures required.

quality_notes.all: Test every distinct color and substrate. Document all results. Retain test records for 3 years per EPA RRP.

tasks.name: DSD-4 Hard Stop Check
tasks.description: If DSD-4 (substrate damage — rot, structural failure, insect damage) is found, HALT painting scope. Document damage, report to project manager/owner. Painting cannot proceed until carpentry repair is complete.

quality_notes.all: Probe all suspect areas. Photo-document all damage. Written report to PM. Do NOT proceed with painting over damaged substrate.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Condition assess → MC test → Coating ID → Lead evaluate (if pre-1978) → DSD-4 gate check. This module MUST complete before any prep or coating work.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Protection Setup
sop_modules.description: Deploy landscape, hardscape, fixture, and vehicle protection. RRP containment if lead-positive. Scope depends on application method (spray requires more coverage).

tasks.name: Landscape Edge Protection
tasks.description: Deploy drop cloth/tarp at landscape bed edges adjacent to siding work area. Prevents debris and wash water contamination.

quality_notes.all: Secure tarps at grade. Extend 3 ft from foundation minimum.

tasks.name: Full Landscape Protection (Spray)
tasks.description: Full tarp over plantings, shrubs, and garden beds within spray drift zone. Required when spray application method is used.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage of all plantings within 10 ft of working elevation. Secure against wind.

tasks.name: Hardscape Protection
tasks.description: Deploy drop cloths on walkways, patios, and driveways adjacent to siding work area.

quality_notes.all: Tape plastic to foundation at grade line. Extend to drip/overspray zone.

tasks.name: Light Fixture Masking
tasks.description: Bag and tape exterior light fixtures on working elevations.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage. Secure tape to prevent seepage during wash and spray.

tasks.name: HVAC Unit Cover
tasks.description: Cover HVAC condenser units adjacent to working elevations.

quality_notes.all: Full cover during active work. Remove promptly after — do not leave covered overnight in warm weather.

tasks.name: Vehicle Protection (Spray)
tasks.description: Tarp vehicles in driveway when spray application method is used on adjacent elevations.

quality_notes.all: Full cover. Secure against wind. Confirm with homeowner before covering.

tasks.name: RRP Lead-Safe Containment Setup
tasks.description: Deploy 6-mil poly ground containment per EPA RRP rule. Extends 10 ft from building or to property line. Vertical containment at openings. Required when lead paint is confirmed on pre-1978 buildings.

quality_notes.all: 10 ft perimeter minimum. Vertical barriers at all openings (doors, windows). Warning signage posted. EPA RRP certified firm and renovator required.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Landscape edge → Full landscape (spray) → Hardscape → Fixtures → HVAC → Vehicle (spray) → RRP containment (if lead-positive). Protection BEFORE any prep disturbance.

sop_modules.name: Substrate-State-Driven Surface Preparation
sop_modules.description: Prep tasks activate based on substrate_state. Sound paint: degloss only. Chalking: dedicated chalk remediation sequence. Failing paint: scrape by severity. Peeling: heavy scrape/strip. Weathered: sand to fresh wood. All states get dust cleanup.

tasks.name: Pressure Wash Siding
tasks.description: Pressure wash all siding surfaces to remove dirt, mildew, chalk, and loose material. Required for all repaint substrate states.

quality_notes.QT2: 2000 PSI. Remove loose material and surface contaminants.
quality_notes.QT3: 2000-2500 PSI. 15° tip. Clean to sound substrate. Allow 24-48 hr dry.
quality_notes.QT4: 2000-2500 PSI. Systematic elevation-by-elevation. Inspect under drying for missed areas. Allow 48 hr dry.

tasks.name: Light Chalk Remediation
tasks.description: Remove light chalk residue by scrub washing with TSP or chalk-binder solution. For chalking state with light severity where power wash alone is insufficient.

quality_notes.all: Scrub until wipe test shows minimal chalk transfer. Rinse thoroughly. Allow full dry.

tasks.name: Heavy Chalk Remediation with Mechanical Sand
tasks.description: Heavy chalk removal — scrub wash followed by mechanical sanding to remove embedded chalk layer. For chalking state with heavy severity.

quality_notes.all: Scrub wash first, dry, then sand until wipe test shows clean surface. No chalk residue remaining.

tasks.name: Light Scraping — DSD-1
tasks.description: Light hand scraping of loose paint areas. For failing_paint state with DSD-1 (minor peeling/cracking, <10% of surface).

quality_notes.all: Remove all loose paint. Feather edges of remaining sound paint.

tasks.name: Moderate Scraping — DSD-2
tasks.description: Moderate hand/power scraping. For failing_paint state with DSD-2 (10-30% of surface area affected).

quality_notes.QT2: Remove all loose paint. Feather edges.
quality_notes.QT3: Remove all loose paint. Feather edges to smooth transition.
quality_notes.QT4: Remove all loose paint. Feather to invisible transition. Power scraper on stubborn areas.

tasks.name: Heavy Scraping / Stripping — DSD-3
tasks.description: Heavy scraping and partial stripping. For peeling state with DSD-3 (>30% of surface, intercoat failure, may require heat or chemical stripping).

quality_notes.QT2: Remove all loose and peeling paint. Feather edges.
quality_notes.QT3: Remove all failing paint. Heat gun for stubborn areas. Feather smooth.
quality_notes.QT4: Complete removal of all compromised coating. Heat/chemical strip as needed. Feather to invisible transition.

tasks.name: Feather Sand Paint Edges
tasks.description: Sand edges of remaining paint to create smooth transition to bare wood. Required after scraping on failing/peeling states.

quality_notes.QT3: Smooth feather at all paint edges. No ridges at 3 ft.
quality_notes.QT4: Invisible feather transitions. Inspect under raking light.

tasks.name: Sand Weathered Wood to Fresh Surface
tasks.description: Sand weathered, grey, UV-damaged wood to reveal fresh wood fiber. Required for weathered state — surface must accept primer penetration.

quality_notes.QT2: Sand grey layer off. Fresh wood visible.
quality_notes.QT3: Full sand to fresh wood. Uniform scratch pattern.
quality_notes.QT4: Complete removal of weathered layer. Inspect for uniform fresh wood surface.

tasks.name: Degloss Existing Sound Paint
tasks.description: Liquid deglosser or light sand for adhesion on sound existing paint. For sound_paint state where coating is intact but glossy.

quality_notes.all: Degloss entire surface. Wipe residue. Surface should feel uniformly dull/matte to touch.

tasks.name: Prep Dust Cleanup
tasks.description: Remove all sanding dust, scraping debris, and wash residue from siding surfaces before coating.

quality_notes.all: All dust removed. Wipe test on random boards shows clean surface. No residue in lap joints or profiles.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Power wash → Chalk remediate (chalking) OR Scrape (failing/peeling) OR Sand weathered (weathered) OR Degloss (sound_paint) → Feather sand (after scraping) → Dust cleanup. Allow 24-48 hr dry after power wash before further prep.

sop_modules.name: Caulk Removal & Application
sop_modules.description: Remove failed caulk and apply new exterior paintable caulk at joints. Repaint-specific: always inspect and replace failed caulk.

tasks.name: Remove Failed Caulk
tasks.description: Cut out and remove all failed, cracked, or separated caulk at siding-to-trim joints, board joints, and penetrations.

quality_notes.all: Remove all failed caulk. Clean joint to sound substrate. No residue in joint.

tasks.name: Apply New Caulk at Joints
tasks.description: Apply exterior paintable sealant caulk at all siding-to-trim joints, board joints, and penetrations. Backer rod for gaps >3/8 inch.

quality_notes.QT2: All open joints caulked. Tool smooth.
quality_notes.QT3: All joints caulked with consistent bead. Tool smooth. No voids.
quality_notes.QT4: Precision bead. Uniform profile. Inspect all joints for complete fill.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Remove old caulk → Apply new caulk. Allow cure per manufacturer spec before top-coating.

sop_modules.name: Substrate-State-Driven Priming
sop_modules.description: Primer selection and coverage determined by substrate_state. Sound paint: spot prime bare spots only. Chalking: chalk-binding primer. Failing >30% / Peeling: full acrylic prime. Weathered: penetrating alkyd primer. Tannin-rich exposed wood: alkyd tannin-blocker.

tasks.name: Spot Prime Bare Areas — Brush
tasks.description: Brush-apply primer to small bare wood spots exposed after scraping. For sound_paint or failing_paint states with <30% bare area.

quality_notes.all: Cover all bare wood. Feather onto sound existing paint. Full hiding on bare spots.

tasks.name: Chalk-Binding Primer — Roll Application
tasks.description: Roll-apply chalk-binding primer to lock down residual chalk and provide adhesion surface. Full coverage for chalking state.

quality_notes.all: Full coverage. Work primer into chalky surface. No holidays. Wipe test after dry shows bound surface.

tasks.name: Chalk-Binding Primer — Spray Application
tasks.description: Spray-apply chalk-binding primer for large chalking areas. Back-brush into substrate for penetration.

quality_notes.all: Spray and immediately back-brush for penetration. No holidays. Full coverage.

tasks.name: Full Acrylic Prime — Spray + Backbrush
tasks.description: Full field prime coat with acrylic bonding primer. Spray application with immediate backbrush for adhesion. For failing >30% bare or peeling states.

quality_notes.all: Full coverage. Even mil build. Back-brush all surfaces for penetration and adhesion.

tasks.name: Full Acrylic Prime — Brush Application
tasks.description: Full field prime coat with acrylic bonding primer. Brush application for detail areas or when spray is not feasible.

quality_notes.all: Full coverage. Work primer into wood grain. Even film build.

tasks.name: Alkyd Tannin-Blocker Prime — Spray
tasks.description: Spray-apply alkyd tannin-blocking primer on exposed tannin-rich wood (cedar, redwood). Prevents bleed-through discoloration.

quality_notes.all: Full coverage on tannin-rich areas. Even mil build. Allow full cure before topcoat.

tasks.name: Alkyd Tannin-Blocker Prime — Brush
tasks.description: Brush-apply alkyd tannin-blocking primer on exposed tannin-rich wood. For detail or limited areas.

quality_notes.all: Full coverage. Work into grain. Even film build on all tannin-rich areas.

tasks.name: Penetrating Alkyd Primer — Brush
tasks.description: Brush-apply penetrating alkyd primer on weathered wood surfaces. Deep penetration consolidates damaged fibers.

quality_notes.all: Generous application. Allow primer to soak in. Second coat on severely weathered areas.

tasks.name: Penetrating Alkyd Primer — Spray
tasks.description: Spray-apply penetrating alkyd primer on large weathered wood areas. Back-brush for deep penetration.

quality_notes.all: Spray heavy wet coat. Immediately back-brush for penetration. Second pass on severely weathered areas.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Primer selection by substrate_state: Sound paint → spot prime only. Chalking → chalk-binding primer. Failing <30% → spot prime. Failing ≥30% / Peeling → full acrylic prime. Weathered → penetrating alkyd. Tannin-rich exposed wood → tannin-blocker (may layer under acrylic prime).

sop_modules.name: Finish Coat 1
sop_modules.description: First finish coat application. Method determined by application_method dimension. QT2 may use this as sole finish coat.

tasks.name: Finish Coat — Spray + Backbrush
tasks.description: Spray finish coat and immediately back-brush into wood profile for adhesion and uniform texture. Primary method for lap and board & batten profiles.

quality_notes.QT2: Even coverage. No drips or holidays.
quality_notes.QT3: Uniform mil build. Back-brush all surfaces. No visible spray pattern at 6 ft.
quality_notes.QT4: Perfect uniformity. Back-brush into all profiles. No defects at arm's length.

tasks.name: Finish Coat — Brush/Roll
tasks.description: Brush and roll finish coat. Brush at edges, transitions, and profiles. Roller for open field areas.

quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage. No brush marks in roller field. Maintain wet edge.
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform film build. No lap marks. Maintain wet edge to natural break points.

tasks.name: Finish Coat — Brush Only
tasks.description: Brush-only finish coat for shingle profile siding or detail areas where spray/roll is not practical.

quality_notes.QT2: Even coverage on all shingle faces and edges.
quality_notes.QT3: Full coverage. Consistent brush texture. No drips in butt joints.
quality_notes.QT4: Full coverage. Even film build. Inspect every shingle face.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: First finish coat. Method determined by application_method. For QT2, this may be the final coat (1-coat finish). QT3/QT4 proceed to interstage and coat 2.

sop_modules.name: Interstage Inspection
sop_modules.description: Inspect first finish coat. Touch up defects. Proceed to coat 2 for QT3/QT4. QT2 skips to final inspect if 1-coat scope.

tasks.name: Interstage Inspection
tasks.description: Inspect first finish coat for holidays, runs, sags, coverage defects, and missed areas.

quality_notes.QT3: Ground-level scan for obvious defects — runs, sags, holidays.
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic elevation inspection at 6 ft viewing distance. Mark all defects.

tasks.name: Interstage Touch-Up
tasks.description: Repair defects found during interstage inspection before applying coat 2.

quality_notes.QT4: Fix all marked defects. Blend repairs into surrounding coating.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect coat 1 → Touch up → Allow recoat time per TDS → Coat 2. QT2 skips this module entirely.

sop_modules.name: Finish Coat 2
sop_modules.description: Second (final) finish coat. Required for QT3/QT4. QT2 accepts 1-coat finish.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray + Backbrush
tasks.description: Second and final finish coat by spray + backbrush. Critical for appearance and film build durability.

quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage. Consistent appearance across all elevations.
quality_notes.QT4: Perfect uniformity. No visible pattern at 6 ft. Consistent mil build.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll
tasks.description: Second finish coat by brush and roller. Final coat.

quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage. No brush marks in roller field. Maintain wet edge.
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform film build. No lap marks. Maintain wet edge to natural break points.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush Only
tasks.description: Second finish coat brush-only for shingle profile or detail areas.

quality_notes.QT4: Full coverage. Even film build. Inspect every shingle face.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Second and final finish coat. QT3/QT4 only. QT2 stops after coat 1.

sop_modules.name: Final Inspection & Touch-Up
sop_modules.description: Final walkthrough of completed siding finish. Touch up defects found during inspection.

tasks.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
tasks.description: Walk all elevations and inspect completed siding finish for defects, holidays, coverage, and appearance.

quality_notes.QT2: Ground-level walkthrough at 10 ft viewing distance.
quality_notes.QT3: Ground-level walkthrough at 6 ft viewing distance. Binoculars for upper.
quality_notes.QT4: Scaffold/lift inspection of all elevations at arm's length. Photo documentation.

tasks.name: Final Touch-Up
tasks.description: Brush touch-up of defects found during final walkthrough inspection.

quality_notes.QT2: Fix obvious defects at ground-level viewing distance.
quality_notes.QT3: Fix all noted defects. Blend seamlessly at 6 ft.
quality_notes.QT4: Fix every defect. Blend repairs at arm's length standard.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Final inspect all elevations → Touch up → Client sign-off.

sop_modules.name: Cleanup & Demobilization
sop_modules.description: Remove all protection materials, clean equipment, RRP cleanup if applicable, scaffold teardown, and site restoration.

tasks.name: Remove All Protection Materials
tasks.description: Remove all masking tape, drop cloths, plastic sheeting, landscape tarps, fixture bags, and vehicle covers.

quality_notes.all: All tape, plastic, and tarps removed. Check for adhesive residue on fixtures.

tasks.name: RRP Lead-Safe Cleanup
tasks.description: EPA RRP-compliant cleanup: HEPA vacuum all surfaces, roll up poly containment inward, double-bag waste, visual inspection, cleaning verification test. Required when lead paint was disturbed.

quality_notes.all: Full RRP protocol. HEPA vacuum all horizontal surfaces within containment. Roll poly inward. Double-bag waste. Pass cleaning verification test. Document all results.

tasks.name: Scaffold / Lift Teardown
tasks.description: Dismantle scaffold, return aerial lift, or stage ladders for removal.

quality_notes.all: All access equipment removed. No damage to landscaping or hardscape from equipment.

tasks.name: Final Site Cleanup & Demobilization
tasks.description: Clean spray equipment, brushes, rollers. Collect all debris — sandpaper, caulk tubes, tape, containers, rags. Restore site to pre-work condition. Load and demobilize.

quality_notes.all: Site restored to pre-work condition. All equipment cleaned and loaded. No debris remaining.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Remove protection → RRP cleanup (if lead) → Scaffold teardown → Final site cleanup & demobilization.
